label: React Router 8 framework mode (ex-Remix)
streaming: streamed (default entry.server: renderToPipeableStream, onShellReady for browsers / onAllReady for bots via isbot)
notes: React Router 7 framework mode is now published as react-router 8 (npm latest 8.5.1); same framework-mode APIs (routes.ts, route-module loader/action, react-router-serve).

react-router-serve = express + compression() + morgan('tiny') request logging to stdout + express.static for build/client, then the request handler. compression only applies when the client sends Accept-Encoding (the load generator sends none).
Loader data is serialized into the HTML (turbo-stream) for hydration.
The default entry.server/entry.client (no custom files) are used.
